meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: Claude 会通过 lsp 系列工具调用语言服务器:检查某个文件或目录的诊断结果、定位符号定义、查找符号引用、查看文档或工作区符号,并校验和执行重命名。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区需要语言服务器的诊断、定义跳转或引用查找等能力时触发。若诊断提示缺少语言服务器,先查 lsp.status。

say.text: 用 lsp 检查这个文件有没有报错
say.note: 返回该文件的诊断信息

say.text: 找到这个符号在哪里定义的
say.note: 返回定义所在文件、行、列

say.text: 把这个符号重命名成新名字,先看是否可行
say.note: 先校验重命名有效性,再应用修改

howto.what_en: Claude can call the lsp tools to query a language server: check diagnostics for a file or directory, jump to a symbol definition, find references, inspect symbols, and validate or apply renames in the workspace.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace. If a server is missing, check lsp.status first.

say_en.text: Run lsp diagnostics on this file
Find where this symbol is defined
Check if renaming this symbol is valid
say_en.note: Validates the rename, then applies it
